item.title: WATCH- Jasprit Bumrah's son Angad joins him as pacer begins training for New Zealand T20Is
item.description: Jasprit Bumrah, Team India's pace spearhead, bowled in the nets with his son, Angad Bumrah, ahead of his return to action in the forthcoming T20I series against New Zealand, which begins on January 21. The T20I leg of the ongoing home white-ball series against the Kiwis marks the Men in Blue's penultimate preparation for the T20 World Cup 2026, which will be co-hosted by India and Sri Lanka. item.title: 'Is there anyone else in country at his level?'- Hanuma Vihari slams journalist for calling Nitish Reddy 'bits and pieces' cricketer
item.description: Hanuma Vihari, veteran Indian batter, has slammed a journalist who called young all-rounder Nitish Kumar Reddy a ‘bits and pieces’ cricketer. This came after India lost the second ODI to New Zealand in Rajkot on January 14 by seven wickets as the BlackCaps leveled the three-ODI series 1-1. item.title: BBL 16 to see the new ‘designated batter and fielder’ rule, similar to IPL’s impact player
item.description: The Big Bash League (BBL) has announced a new playing condition for the next season of BBL in 2026-27, or BBL 16. This new playing condition will see each side naming a ‘designated batter and fielder’ for each game before the bat flip. This rule is an evolved version of the X-factor rule that was introduced in BBL 10. item.title: Players’ boycott of BPL 2025-26 match forces BCB to sack director M Nazmul Islam- Report
item.description: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) has bowed to the pressure caused by the pressure of the players’ boycott and sacked director and finance committee chairman Nazmul Islam, reports stated. This followed the cancellation of the first Bangladesh Premier League (BPL 2025-26) match on January 14 due to the teams' refusal to show up for the game at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium in Mirpur. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “Being an all-rounder is not easy,” Chopra, Uthappa, Tiwary call for patience with under-fire Nitish Kumar Reddy
item.description: India all-rounder Nitish Kumar Reddy has come under severe scrutiny for his underwhelming display in the second ODI against New Zealand in Rajkot on Wednesday (January 14). Reddy, the sole change in India's playing XI for the second ODI, scored 20 off 21 balls while batting at No. 7 and returned with the bowling figures of 0/13 in two overs. item.title: Mustafizur Rahman dropped idea of taking legal action against KKR after being released from IPL 2026 contract
item.description: Earlier this month, Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) released Mustafizur Rahman from their Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 roster after receiving the BCCI’s directive. Mustafizur, the only Bangladeshi representative in the upcoming IPL season, was signed by KKR for Rs 9.2 crore in the mini-auction last month. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: WATCH- ‘He came to bat when Virat got out..”- Ravi Shastri praises KL Rahul’s 112* on slow pitch in Rajkot ODI
item.description: Former Indian head coach Ravi Shastri and Ian Smith praised India's star batsman KL Rahul for scoring his eighth ODI century against New Zealand in the second ODI on Wednesday. Shastri praised Rahul's extraordinary effort, saying he deserved full credit for turning things around for India after going in to bat at 118/4. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: ‘Team is suffering’- Kris Srikkanth highlights Axar Patel’s absence as India struggles for 6th bowling option
item.description: At a time when Ravindra Jadeja's form has declined, and the team is in dire need of a dependable sixth bowling option, former Indian batter Kris Srikkanth has questioned India's team balance in ODIs, pointing to Axar Patel's ongoing absence. item.description: Former India cricketer Manoj Tiwary has expressed strong views amid Bangladesh's anxiety over traveling to India for the forthcoming T20 World Cup, stating that sporting relations should not be maintained when humanitarian concerns are involved.
